For Immediate Release—November 10th, 2026




     South Carolina Public Service Commission Schedules Allowable Ex Parte
                  Communication Briefing for March 10th, 2027

Columbia, South Carolina—The Public Service Commission of South Carolina has scheduled an allowable ex
parte communication briefing for 10 a.m. on Wednesday, March 10th, 2027. The topic of this allowable ex parte
communication briefing, which comes at the request of the Southeast Energy Efficiency Alliance, will be
“Large Load Partnerships: Unlocking Energy Savings for South Carolina Customers.” This matter is filed with
the Commission under Non-Docketed Item 2026-30-E and all materials filed in this matter are available at this
link.

Those interested in watching this briefing can attend in person at the Commission's office at 101 Executive
Center Drive, Suite 100, Columbia, SC 29210. Registration is required for all in-person attendees so that the
record can be certified as required by law; registration will be available upon arrival at the Commission’s office.

An allowable ex parte communication briefing is a form of communication between the PSC and a person or
organization involved in a PSC docket or nondocketed item that is conducted in accordance with SC Code Ann.
Section 58-3-260(D)(6)(a). Allowable ex parte communication briefings allow the PSC to receive information
from persons involved in matters that come before or are likely to come before the Commission without
violating the ethical standards to which the PSC adheres.

More information about this allowable ex parte communication briefing can be found on the
Commission’s Docket Management System at this link. A recording of the briefing may be viewed
online once it concludes and can be found at this link.

For more information, follow the Commission on Facebook, LinkedIn, Nextdoor, and Instagram, email
contact@psc.sc.gov, or call 803.896.5100.
